response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with a long track record in web, backend, and tooling work, but the profile does not match this role's core requirements. The position demands native-level Japanese, deep C/UNIX embedded firmware development, Linux kernel investigation and source modification, and hands-on network security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, captive portal) plus L2/L3 switching knowledge. His resume shows only brief C/C++ exposure (National Instruments, 2014-2015, IDE components) and a C++ audio thesis, with the last decade focused on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and cloud/web platforms. No Japanese language ability is listed, and no switch, chip-SDK, or security-protocol experience appears anywhere.
strengths: Broad, deep engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Strong testing/TDD, CI/CD, and developer-tooling craftsmanship
Some low-level C/C++ and Linux exposure plus low-latency systems work
concerns: No evidence of Japanese proficiency (hard requirement)
No embedded firmware, switch, or network security experience
C/UNIX and Linux kernel work is minimal and over a decade old
